metadata.title: Socratic AI | Philosophy, Critical Thinking & Deep Conversations
metadata.description: Socratic AI: An AI thinking partner for philosophy, critical thinking, and deep conversation. Built on Socratic dialogue, it challenges your reasoning, sharpens your arguments, and helps you think more clearly.

items.leftDescription: Have the discussions your daily life doesn't make room for.
items.rightTitle: Finally Someone to Think Out Loud With.
items.rightDescription: Have the deep conversations you've always wanted, at any hour, with someone who takes you seriously. No judgment, no distraction. Just thinking. Together.
items.placeholderLabel: Philosophy conversation scene for deep dialogue

items.leftDescription: Debate with our AI that never goes easy on you, so the real thing feels effortless.
items.rightTitle: Turn Your Ideas Into Powerful Arguments.
items.rightDescription: It maps every claim you make, tracks your logic in real time, and fires back with the most precise counter it can find; then turns around and guides you toward the stronger version of it.
items.placeholderLabel: Debate practice visualization with structured arguments

items.leftDescription: Dive into any philosophical idea or thinker and actually come out understanding it.
items.rightTitle: The Entire History of Human Thought, Ready to Discuss.
items.rightDescription: Understand any philosopher, any idea, the way it was always meant to be - through conversation, not a textbook. From the ancient Greeks to modern existentialists, from Stoicism to Nihilism.
items.placeholderLabel: Classical architecture visual representing the history of philosophy
